#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Antivirus Configuration for Trojan Prevention
This script configures and optimizes antivirus software for maximum
protection against trojans and other malware.
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import time
import argparse
import subprocess
import platform
import shutil
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from colorama import init, Fore, Style

init(autoreset=True)

class AntivirusConfig:
    """
    Antivirus Configuration and Optimization Tool
    """
    
    def __init__(self, config_file="av_config.json"):
        """
        Initialize Antivirus Configuration
        
        Args:
            config_file: Configuration file path
        """
        self.config_file = config_file
        self.config = self.load_config()
        self.system = platform.system()
        
        # Default configuration
        self.default_config = {
            'scan_settings': {
                'real_time_protection': True,
                'heuristic_analysis': True,
                'cloud_lookup': True,
                'behavior_monitor': True,
                'script_scanning': True,
                'email_scanning': True,
                'network_scanning': True,
                'removable_drive_scan': True
            },
            'scan_schedule': {
                'quick_scan': 'daily',
                'full_scan': 'weekly',
                'custom_scan': 'never'
            },
            'scan_paths': [
                str(Path.home()),
                'C:\\' if os.name == 'nt' else '/'
            ],
            'exclusions': {
                'paths': [],
                'extensions': [],
                'processes': []
            },
            'detection_settings': {
                'heuristic_level': 'medium',  # low, medium, high
                'pup_detection': True,
                'suspicious_behavior': True,
                'potential_threats': True
            },
            'update_settings': {
                'auto_update': True,
                'update_interval': 3600,  # 1 hour
                'update_source': 'official'
            },
            'quarantine_settings': {
                'auto_quarantine': True,
                'quarantine_days': 30,
                'max_quarantine_size': 1024  # MB
            },
            'logging': {
                'enabled': True,
                'log_level': 'info',
                'max_log_size': 10,  # MB
                'log_retention': 30  # days
            },
            'performance': {
                'scan_priority': 'normal',  # low, normal, high
                'cpu_limit': 50,  # percent
                'io_limit': 50,  # percent
                'scan_on_idle': True
            },
            'notifications': {
                'show_popups': True,
                'email_alerts': False,
                'email_address': '',
                'sound_alerts': True
            }
        }
    
    def load_config(self):
        """Load configuration from file"""
        if os.path.exists(self.config_file):
            try:
                with open(self.config_file, 'r') as f:
                    return json.load(f)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Error loading config: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        return self.default_config.copy()
    
    def save_config(self):
        """Save configuration to file"""
        try:
            with open(self.config_file, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(self.config, f, indent=2)
            print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Configuration saved to {self.config_file}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error saving config: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return False
    
    def configure_windows_defender(self):
        """Configure Windows Defender"""
        if self.system != 'Windows':
            print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Windows Defender only available on Windows{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return False
        
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Configuring Windows Defender...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        try:
            # Enable real-time protection
            subprocess.run([
                'powershell', '-Command',
                'Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $false'
            ], check=True)
            
            # Enable cloud-delivered protection
            subprocess.run([
                'powershell', '-Command',
                'Set-MpPreference -MAPSReporting Advanced'
            ], check=True)
            
            # Enable sample submission
            subprocess.run([
                'powershell', '-Command',
                'Set-MpPreference -SubmitSamplesConsent SendAllSamples'
            ], check=True)
            
            # Set heuristic level
            levels = {'low': 1, 'medium': 2, 'high': 3}
            level = levels.get(self.config['detection_settings']['heuristic_level'], 2)
            subprocess.run([
                'powershell', '-Command',
                f'Set-MpPreference -PUAProtection Enabled -CloudBlockLevel High'
            ], check=True)
            
            # Configure scan settings
            subprocess.run([
                'powershell', '-Command',
                'Set-MpPreference -DisableArchiveScanning $false'
            ], check=True)
            
            subprocess.run([
                'powershell', '-Command',
                'Set-MpPreference -DisableBehaviorMonitoring $false'
            ], check=True)
            
            # Set scan schedule
            if self.config['scan_schedule']['quick_scan'] == 'daily':
                subprocess.run([
                    'powershell', '-Command',
                    'Set-MpPreference -ScanScheduleDay Everyday -ScanScheduleTime 1200'
                ], check=True)
            
            # Configure exclusions
            for path in self.config['exclusions']['paths']:
                subprocess.run([
                    'powershell', '-Command',
                    f'Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath "{path}"'
                ], check=True)
            
            # Update signatures
            subprocess.run(['powershell', '-Command', 'Update-MpSignature'], check=True)
            
            print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Windows Defender configured successfully{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return True
            
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
            print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error configuring Windows Defender: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return False
    
    def configure_clamav(self):
        """Configure ClamAV (cross-platform)"""
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Configuring ClamAV...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        # Check if ClamAV is installed
        if not shutil.which('clamscan'):
            print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] ClamAV not found. Installing...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            self.install_clamav()
        
        try:
            # Create ClamAV config directory
            if self.system == 'Windows':
                conf_dir = 'C:\\Program Files\\ClamAV'
            else:
                conf_dir = '/etc/clamav'
            
            os.makedirs(conf_dir, exist_ok=True)
            
            # Generate freshclam.conf
            freshclam_conf = os.path.join(conf_dir, 'freshclam.conf')
            with open(freshclam_conf, 'w') as f:
                f.write("""# freshclam configuration
DatabaseMirror database.clamav.net
DatabaseMirror db.local.clamav.net
UpdateLogFile /var/log/freshclam.log
LogTime yes
LogVerbose no
DatabaseOwner clamav
DatabaseDirectory /var/lib/clamav
NotifyClamd /etc/clamav/clamd.conf
""")
            
            # Generate clamd.conf
            clamd_conf = os.path.join(conf_dir, 'clamd.conf')
            with open(clamd_conf, 'w') as f:
                f.write("""# clamd configuration
LogFile /var/log/clamd.log
LogTime yes
LogVerbose no
LogRotate yes
ExtendedDetectionInfo yes
PidFile /var/run/clamd.pid
TemporaryDirectory /tmp
DatabaseDirectory /var/lib/clamav
LocalSocket /var/run/clamav/clamd.ctl
FixStaleSocket yes
TCPSocket 3310
TCPAddr 127.0.0.1
MaxConnectionQueueLength 30
StreamMaxLength 100M
ScanPE yes
ScanELF yes
ScanMail yes
ScanOLE2 yes
ScanHTML yes
ScanPDF yes
MaxScanSize 100M
MaxFileSize 25M
MaxRecursion 10
MaxFiles 10000
""")
            
            print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] ClamAV configured successfully{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return True
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error configuring ClamAV: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return False
    
    def install_clamav(self):
        """Install ClamAV"""
        if self.system == 'Linux':
            try:
                if os.path.exists('/etc/debian_version'):
                    subprocess.run(['sudo', 'apt-get', 'update'], check=True)
                    subprocess.run(['sudo', 'apt-get', 'install', '-y', 'clamav', 'clamav-daemon'], check=True)
                elif os.path.exists('/etc/redhat-release'):
                    subprocess.run(['sudo', 'yum', 'install', '-y', 'clamav', 'clamavd'], check=True)
                
                print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] ClamAV installed{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error installing ClamAV: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        elif self.system == 'Windows':
            print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Please download ClamAV from: https://www.clamav.net/downloads{Style.RESET_ALL}")
    
    def create_scan_script(self):
        """Create custom scan script"""
        script_content = """#!/bin/bash
# Custom Antivirus Scan Script

SCAN_LOG="/var/log/av_scan.log"
SCAN_DATE=$(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

echo "[$SCAN_DATE] Starting antivirus scan..." >> $SCAN_LOG

# Scan with ClamAV
if command -v clamscan &> /dev/null; then
    clamscan -r --bell -i /home/$USER >> $SCAN_LOG 2>&1
fi

# Check Windows Defender on Windows
if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]]; then
    powershell -Command "Start-MpScan -ScanType QuickScan" >> $SCAN_LOG 2>&1
fi

echo "[$SCAN_DATE] Scan completed" >> $SCAN_LOG
"""
        
        script_path = 'av_scan.sh'
        with open(script_path, 'w') as f:
            f.write(script_content)
        
        os.chmod(script_path, 0o755)
        print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Scan script created: {script_path}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        return script_path
    
    def configure_cron_job(self):
        """Configure scheduled scans using cron"""
        if self.system != 'Linux':
            print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Cron jobs only available on Linux{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return False
        
        script_path = self.create_scan_script()
        
        # Create crontab entry
        cron_line = f"0 2 * * * {os.path.abspath(script_path)}"
        
        try:
            # Get existing crontab
            result = subprocess.run(['crontab', '-l'], capture_output=True, text=True)
            current_cron = result.stdout
            
            # Add new line if not exists
            if cron_line not in current_cron:
                new_cron = current_cron + cron_line + '\n'
                
                # Save to temp file
                with open('/tmp/crontab.txt', 'w') as f:
                    f.write(new_cron)
                
                # Install new crontab
                subprocess.run(['crontab', '/tmp/crontab.txt'], check=True)
                os.remove('/tmp/crontab.txt')
                
                print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Scheduled scan configured (daily at 2 AM){Style.RESET_ALL}")
            
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error configuring cron: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
    
    def configure_windows_task(self):
        """Configure scheduled scan using Windows Task Scheduler"""
        if self.system != 'Windows':
            print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Task Scheduler only available on Windows{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return False
        
        try:
            # Create scheduled task for daily scan
            subprocess.run([
                'schtasks', '/create', '/tn', 'AVScan', '/tr', 
                'powershell -Command "Start-MpScan -ScanType QuickScan"',
                '/sc', 'daily', '/st', '02:00', '/f'
            ], check=True)
            
            print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Scheduled scan configured (daily at 2 AM){Style.RESET_ALL}")
            
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
            print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error configuring task: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
    
    def add_exclusion(self, path):
        """Add exclusion path"""
        if path not in self.config['exclusions']['paths']:
            self.config['exclusions']['paths'].append(path)
            self.save_config()
            print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Added exclusion: {path}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            
            # Apply to Windows Defender if on Windows
            if self.system == 'Windows':
                try:
                    subprocess.run([
                        'powershell', '-Command',
                        f'Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath "{path}"'
                    ], check=True)
                    print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Applied to Windows Defender{Style.RESET_ALL}")
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error applying to Defender: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
    
    def run_quick_scan(self):
        """Run quick system scan"""
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Running quick scan...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        if self.system == 'Windows':
            try:
                subprocess.run([
                    'powershell', '-Command',
                    'Start-MpScan -ScanType QuickScan'
                ], check=True)
                print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Quick scan completed{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error running scan: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        elif shutil.which('clamscan'):
            try:
                subprocess.run([
                    'clamscan', '-r', '--bell', '-i', str(Path.home())
                ], check=True)
                print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Quick scan completed{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error running scan: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
    
    def update_signatures(self):
        """Update antivirus signatures"""
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Updating virus definitions...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        if self.system == 'Windows':
            try:
                subprocess.run(['powershell', '-Command', 'Update-MpSignature'], check=True)
                print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Windows Defender signatures updated{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error updating signatures: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        elif shutil.which('freshclam'):
            try:
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'freshclam'], check=True)
                print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] ClamAV signatures updated{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error updating signatures: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
    
    def show_status(self):
        """Show current protection status"""
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}{'='*50}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        print(f"{Fore.CYAN}📊 PROTECTION STATUS{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        print(f"{Fore.CYAN}{'='*50}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        # Show configuration
        print(f"\n{Fore.GREEN}Scan Settings:{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        for setting, value in self.config['scan_settings'].items():
            status = f"{Fore.GREEN}Enabled{Style.RESET_ALL}" if value else f"{Fore.RED}Disabled{Style.RESET_ALL}"
            print(f"  {setting}: {status}")
        
        print(f"\n{Fore.GREEN}Detection Settings:{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        print(f"  Heuristic Level: {self.config['detection_settings']['heuristic_level']}")
        print(f"  PUP Detection: {self.config['detection_settings']['pup_detection']}")
        
        print(f"\n{Fore.GREEN}Exclusions:{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        print(f"  Paths: {len(self.config['exclusions']['paths'])}")
        print(f"  Extensions: {len(self.config['exclusions']['extensions'])}")
        print(f"  Processes: {len(self.config['exclusions']['processes'])}")
        
        # Show Windows Defender status if available
        if self.system == 'Windows':
            try:
                result = subprocess.run([
                    'powershell', '-Command',
                    'Get-MpComputerStatus | Select-Object -Property *'
                ], capture_output=True, text=True)
                print(f"\n{Fore.GREEN}Windows Defender Status:{Style.RESET_ALL}")
                print(result.stdout)
            except:
                pass
        
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}{'='*50}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
    
    def interactive_menu(self):
        """Interactive configuration menu"""
        while True:
            print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}{'='*50}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            print(f"{Fore.CYAN}ANTIVIRUS CONFIGURATION MENU{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            print(f"{Fore.CYAN}{'='*50}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            print("1. Configure Windows Defender")
            print("2. Configure ClamAV")
            print("3. Run Quick Scan")
            print("4. Update Signatures")
            print("5. Add Exclusion Path")
            print("6. Configure Scheduled Scans")
            print("7. View Status")
            print("8. Save Configuration")
            print("9. Reset to Defaults")
            print("0. Exit")
            
            choice = input(f"\n{Fore.YELLOW}Enter choice: {Style.RESET_ALL}")
            
            if choice == '1':
                self.configure_windows_defender()
            elif choice == '2':
                self.configure_clamav()
            elif choice == '3':
                self.run_quick_scan()
            elif choice == '4':
                self.update_signatures()
            elif choice == '5':
                path = input("Enter path to exclude: ")
                self.add_exclusion(path)
            elif choice == '6':
                if self.system == 'Windows':
                    self.configure_windows_task()
                else:
                    self.configure_cron_job()
            elif choice == '7':
                self.show_status()
            elif choice == '8':
                self.save_config()
            elif choice == '9':
                self.config = self.default_config.copy()
                self.save_config()
                print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Reset to defaults{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            elif choice == '0':
                break

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Antivirus Configuration Tool')
    parser.add_argument('--config', default='av_config.json', help='Configuration file')
    parser.add_argument('--scan', action='store_true', help='Run quick scan')
    parser.add_argument('--update', action='store_true', help='Update signatures')
    parser.add_argument('--status', action='store_true', help='Show protection status')
    parser.add_argument('--interactive', action='store_true', help='Interactive mode')
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    av = AntivirusConfig(config_file=args.config)
    
    if args.scan:
        av.run_quick_scan()
    elif args.update:
        av.update_signatures()
    elif args.status:
        av.show_status()
    elif args.interactive:
        av.interactive_menu()
    else:
        print("Use --interactive for menu or --help for options")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Sandbox Setup for Trojan Analysis
This script sets up an isolated sandbox environment for safely analyzing
suspicious files and potential trojans.
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import time
import argparse
import subprocess
import platform
import shutil
import tempfile
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from colorama import init, Fore, Style

init(autoreset=True)

class SandboxSetup:
    """
    Sandbox Environment Setup for Malware Analysis
    """
    
    def __init__(self, sandbox_dir="/sandbox", network_isolation=True,
                 snapshot_enabled=True, log_file="sandbox.log"):
        """
        Initialize Sandbox Setup
        
        Args:
            sandbox_dir: Sandbox directory
            network_isolation: Enable network isolation
            snapshot_enabled: Enable VM snapshots
            log_file: Log file path
        """
        self.sandbox_dir = sandbox_dir
        self.network_isolation = network_isolation
        self.snapshot_enabled = snapshot_enabled
        self.log_file = log_file
        
        self.system = platform.system()
        self.sandbox_ready = False
        
        # Create sandbox directory
        os.makedirs(sandbox_dir, exist_ok=True)
        
        # Sandbox components
        self.components = {
            'virtualization': None,
            'network': None,
            'monitoring': None,
            'isolation': None
        }
        
        # Statistics
        self.stats = {
            'samples_analyzed': 0,
            'suspicious_files': 0,
            'network_connections': 0,
            'start_time': time.time()
        }
        
        # Setup logging
        self.setup_logging()
    
    def setup_logging(self):
        """Setup logging"""
        import logging
        logging.basicConfig(
            level=logging.INFO,
            format='%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s',
            handlers=[
                logging.FileHandler(self.log_file),
                logging.StreamHandler()
            ]
        )
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    
    def check_prerequisites(self):
        """Check system prerequisites"""
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Checking prerequisites...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        checks = []
        
        # Check virtualization support
        if self.system == 'Linux':
            # Check KVM support
            if os.path.exists('/dev/kvm'):
                checks.append(('KVM', True))
                self.components['virtualization'] = 'kvm'
            else:
                checks.append(('KVM', False))
        
        # Check Docker
        if shutil.which('docker'):
            checks.append(('Docker', True))
            if not self.components['virtualization']:
                self.components['virtualization'] = 'docker'
        else:
            checks.append(('Docker', False))
        
        # Check VirtualBox
        if shutil.which('vboxmanage') or shutil.which('VBoxManage'):
            checks.append(('VirtualBox', True))
            self.components['virtualization'] = 'virtualbox'
        else:
            checks.append(('VirtualBox', False))
        
        # Check network isolation tools
        if shutil.which('iptables'):
            checks.append(('iptables', True))
            self.components['network'] = 'iptables'
        else:
            checks.append(('iptables', False))
        
        # Check monitoring tools
        monitoring_tools = ['strace', 'ltrace', 'tcpdump', 'wireshark']
        available = []
        for tool in monitoring_tools:
            if shutil.which(tool):
                available.append(tool)
        
        if available:
            checks.append(('Monitoring tools', True))
            self.components['monitoring'] = available
        else:
            checks.append(('Monitoring tools', False))
        
        # Display results
        for check, status in checks:
            status_str = f"{Fore.GREEN}✓{Style.RESET_ALL}" if status else f"{Fore.RED}✗{Style.RESET_ALL}"
            print(f"  {status_str} {check}")
        
        return all(status for _, status in checks if _ != 'Monitoring tools')  # Monitoring tools optional
    
    def setup_network_isolation(self):
        """Setup network isolation"""
        if not self.network_isolation:
            print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Network isolation disabled{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return True
        
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Setting up network isolation...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        if self.system == 'Linux':
            try:
                # Create network namespace
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'netns', 'add', 'sandbox_ns'], check=True)
                
                # Create virtual Ethernet pair
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'link', 'add', 'veth0', 'type', 'veth', 'peer', 'name', 'veth1'], check=True)
                
                # Move one end to namespace
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'link', 'set', 'veth1', 'netns', 'sandbox_ns'], check=True)
                
                # Configure interfaces
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'addr', 'add', '192.168.100.1/24', 'dev', 'veth0'], check=True)
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'link', 'set', 'veth0', 'up'], check=True)
                
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'netns', 'exec', 'sandbox_ns', 'ip', 'addr', 'add', '192.168.100.2/24', 'dev', 'veth1'], check=True)
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'netns', 'exec', 'sandbox_ns', 'ip', 'link', 'set', 'veth1', 'up'], check=True)
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'netns', 'exec', 'sandbox_ns', 'ip', 'link', 'set', 'lo', 'up'], check=True)
                
                # Block external internet (allow only local network)
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'netns', 'exec', 'sandbox_ns', 'iptables', '-P', 'INPUT', 'DROP'], check=True)
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'netns', 'exec', 'sandbox_ns', 'iptables', '-P', 'FORWARD', 'DROP'], check=True)
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'netns', 'exec', 'sandbox_ns', 'iptables', '-P', 'OUTPUT', 'DROP'], check=True)
                
                # Allow local network
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'netns', 'exec', 'sandbox_ns', 'iptables', '-A', 'INPUT', '-s', '192.168.100.0/24', '-j', 'ACCEPT'], check=True)
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'netns', 'exec', 'sandbox_ns', 'iptables', '-A', 'OUTPUT', '-d', '192.168.100.0/24', '-j', 'ACCEPT'], check=True)
                
                print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Network namespace created and isolated{Style.RESET_ALL}")
                return True
                
            except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
                print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error setting up network isolation: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
                return False
        
        elif self.system == 'Windows':
            print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Network isolation on Windows requires Hyper-V or manual setup{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return False
    
    def setup_docker_sandbox(self):
        """Setup Docker-based sandbox"""
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Setting up Docker sandbox...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        try:
            # Pull analysis image
            subprocess.run(['docker', 'pull', 'remnux/remnux-distro'], check=True)
            
            # Create sandbox container
            container_name = f"sandbox_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}"
            
            docker_args = [
                'docker', 'run', '-d',
                '--name', container_name,
                '--cap-drop=ALL',  # Drop all capabilities
                '--security-opt=no-new-privileges',
                '--read-only',  # Read-only root filesystem
                '-v', f"{self.sandbox_dir}:/sandbox:ro",  # Mount samples read-only
            ]
            
            # Add network isolation
            if self.network_isolation:
                docker_args.append('--network=none')
            
            docker_args.append('remnux/remnux-distro')
            docker_args.append('tail')
            docker_args.append('-f')
            docker_args.append('/dev/null')
            
            subprocess.run(docker_args, check=True)
            
            print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Docker sandbox created: {container_name}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            self.components['isolation'] = f"docker:{container_name}"
            return True
            
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
            print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error setting up Docker sandbox: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return False
    
    def setup_virtualbox_sandbox(self):
        """Setup VirtualBox sandbox"""
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Setting up VirtualBox sandbox...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        vboxmanage = shutil.which('VBoxManage') or shutil.which('vboxmanage')
        if not vboxmanage:
            print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] VirtualBox not found{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return False
        
        try:
            # Create VM
            vm_name = f"Sandbox_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}"
            
            # Create VM
            subprocess.run([vboxmanage, 'createvm', '--name', vm_name, '--register'], check=True)
            
            # Configure VM
            subprocess.run([vboxmanage, 'modifyvm', vm_name, '--memory', '2048'], check=True)
            subprocess.run([vboxmanage, 'modifyvm', vm_name, '--cpus', '2'], check=True)
            
            # Network configuration
            if self.network_isolation:
                subprocess.run([vboxmanage, 'modifyvm', vm_name, '--nic1', 'hostonly'], check=True)
                subprocess.run([vboxmanage, 'modifyvm', vm_name, '--hostonlyadapter1', 'vboxnet0'], check=True)
            else:
                subprocess.run([vboxmanage, 'modifyvm', vm_name, '--nic1', 'nat'], check=True)
            
            # Disable unnecessary features
            subprocess.run([vboxmanage, 'modifyvm', vm_name, '--clipboard', 'disabled'], check=True)
            subprocess.run([vboxmanage, 'modifyvm', vm_name, '--draganddrop', 'disabled'], check=True)
            subprocess.run([vboxmanage, 'modifyvm', vm_name, '--audio', 'none'], check=True)
            subprocess.run([vboxmanage, 'modifyvm', vm_name, '--usb', 'off'], check=True)
            
            # Create snapshot for easy revert
            if self.snapshot_enabled:
                subprocess.run([vboxmanage, 'snapshot', vm_name, 'take', 'clean_state'], check=True)
            
            print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] VirtualBox sandbox created: {vm_name}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            self.components['isolation'] = f"virtualbox:{vm_name}"
            return True
            
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
            print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error setting up VirtualBox sandbox: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return False
    
    def setup_monitoring(self):
        """Setup monitoring tools"""
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Setting up monitoring...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        monitor_dir = os.path.join(self.sandbox_dir, 'monitoring')
        os.makedirs(monitor_dir, exist_ok=True)
        
        # Create monitoring script
        monitor_script = os.path.join(monitor_dir, 'monitor.sh')
        with open(monitor_script, 'w') as f:
            f.write("""#!/bin/bash
# Sandbox Monitoring Script

MONITOR_DIR="$(dirname "$0")"
PID=$1

# Monitor system calls
if command -v strace &> /dev/null; then
    sudo strace -p $PID -o "$MONITOR_DIR/strace.log" &
fi

# Monitor network traffic
if command -v tcpdump &> /dev/null; then
    sudo tcpdump -i any -w "$MONITOR_DIR/network.pcap" &
fi

# Monitor file changes
inotifywait -m -r --format '%w%f' / 2>/dev/null | while read file; do
    echo "$(date): $file" >> "$MONITOR_DIR/file_changes.log"
done &

wait
""")
        
        os.chmod(monitor_script, 0o755)
        
        # Create analysis script
        analysis_script = os.path.join(monitor_dir, 'analyze.sh')
        with open(analysis_script, 'w') as f:
            f.write("""#!/bin/bash
# Sandbox Analysis Script

ANALYSIS_DIR="$(dirname "$0")"

echo "=== Sandbox Analysis Report ==="
echo "Date: $(date)"
echo

# Check for suspicious system calls
if [ -f "$ANALYSIS_DIR/strace.log" ]; then
    echo "=== Suspicious System Calls ==="
    grep -E "socket|connect|execve|ptrace" "$ANALYSIS_DIR/strace.log"
    echo
fi

# Check for network connections
if [ -f "$ANALYSIS_DIR/network.pcap" ]; then
    echo "=== Network Connections ==="
    tcpdump -r "$ANALYSIS_DIR/network.pcap" -n 2>/dev/null | head -20
    echo
fi

# Check for file changes
if [ -f "$ANALYSIS_DIR/file_changes.log" ]; then
    echo "=== File System Changes ==="
    cat "$ANALYSIS_DIR/file_changes.log" | head -20
    echo
fi

echo "=== Analysis Complete ==="
""")
        
        os.chmod(analysis_script, 0o755)
        
        print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Monitoring setup complete in {monitor_dir}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        self.components['monitoring'] = monitor_dir
        
        return True
    
    def prepare_sample_directory(self):
        """Prepare directory for samples"""
        samples_dir = os.path.join(self.sandbox_dir, 'samples')
        results_dir = os.path.join(self.sandbox_dir, 'results')
        
        os.makedirs(samples_dir, exist_ok=True)
        os.makedirs(results_dir, exist_ok=True)
        
        print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Sample directory: {samples_dir}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Results directory: {results_dir}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        return samples_dir, results_dir
    
    def create_sandbox_config(self):
        """Create sandbox configuration file"""
        config = {
            'sandbox_id': datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S'),
            'created': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'components': self.components,
            'settings': {
                'network_isolation': self.network_isolation,
                'snapshot_enabled': self.snapshot_enabled,
                'sandbox_dir': self.sandbox_dir
            },
            'stats': self.stats
        }
        
        config_file = os.path.join(self.sandbox_dir, 'sandbox_config.json')
        with open(config_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(config, f, indent=2)
        
        print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Sandbox configuration saved to {config_file}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        return config_file
    
    def analyze_sample(self, sample_path):
        """Analyze a sample in the sandbox"""
        if not os.path.exists(sample_path):
            print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Sample not found: {sample_path}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return None
        
        # Copy sample to sandbox
        sample_name = os.path.basename(sample_path)
        sandbox_sample = os.path.join(self.sandbox_dir, 'samples', 
                                      f"{int(time.time())}_{sample_name}")
        shutil.copy2(sample_path, sandbox_sample)
        
        # Calculate hash
        with open(sandbox_sample, 'rb') as f:
            file_hash = hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest()
        
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Analyzing sample: {sample_name}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        print(f"{Fore.CYAN}    SHA256: {file_hash}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        self.stats['samples_analyzed'] += 1
        
        # Analysis depends on virtualization type
        if 'docker:' in str(self.components.get('isolation', '')):
            container = self.components['isolation'].split(':')[1]
            
            try:
                # Copy sample to container
                subprocess.run([
                    'docker', 'cp', sandbox_sample,
                    f"{container}:/tmp/{sample_name}"
                ], check=True)
                
                # Run monitoring
                monitor_dir = self.components.get('monitoring')
                if monitor_dir:
                    # This is simplified - real analysis would be more complex
                    print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Sample copied to container for analysis{Style.RESET_ALL}")
                    print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Manual analysis required in container{Style.RESET_ALL}")
                
                return {
                    'sample': sample_name,
                    'hash': file_hash,
                    'sandbox_path': sandbox_sample,
                    'container': container
                }
                
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Error analyzing sample: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
                return None
        
        else:
            print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Virtualization not available - manual analysis required{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return {
                'sample': sample_name,
                'hash': file_hash,
                'sandbox_path': sandbox_sample
            }
    
    def cleanup(self):
        """Clean up sandbox resources"""
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Cleaning up sandbox...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        # Remove network namespace
        if self.network_isolation and self.system == 'Linux':
            try:
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'netns', 'delete', 'sandbox_ns'], check=True)
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'ip', 'link', 'delete', 'veth0'], check=True)
                print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Network namespace removed{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            except:
                pass
        
        # Remove Docker containers
        if 'docker:' in str(self.components.get('isolation', '')):
            container = self.components['isolation'].split(':')[1]
            try:
                subprocess.run(['docker', 'stop', container], check=True)
                subprocess.run(['docker', 'rm', container], check=True)
                print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Docker container removed{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            except:
                pass
        
        print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Cleanup complete{Style.RESET_ALL}")
    
    def setup(self):
        """Complete sandbox setup"""
        print(f"""
        {Fore.CYAN}╔═══════════════════════════════════════╗
        ║        Sandbox Setup Tool           ║
        ║      Trojan Analysis Environment    ║
        ╚═══════════════════════════════════════╝{Style.RESET_ALL}
        """)
        
        print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] WARNING: This sets up an isolated environment{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Only use for legitimate security research{Style.RESET_ALL}\n")
        
        # Check prerequisites
        if not self.check_prerequisites():
            print(f"{Fore.RED}[✗] Prerequisites not met{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return False
        
        # Setup network isolation
        if self.network_isolation:
            self.setup_network_isolation()
        
        # Setup virtualization
        if self.components['virtualization'] == 'docker':
            self.setup_docker_sandbox()
        elif self.components['virtualization'] == 'virtualbox':
            self.setup_virtualbox_sandbox()
        else:
            print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] No virtualization available - using host with restrictions{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        # Setup monitoring
        self.setup_monitoring()
        
        # Prepare directories
        self.prepare_sample_directory()
        
        # Create config
        self.create_sandbox_config()
        
        self.sandbox_ready = True
        
        print(f"\n{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Sandbox setup complete!{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        print(f"{Fore.GREEN}    Sandbox directory: {self.sandbox_dir}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        return True
    
    def interactive_menu(self):
        """Interactive sandbox menu"""
        if not self.sandbox_ready:
            print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Sandbox not set up. Run setup first.{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return
        
        while True:
            print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}{'='*50}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            print(f"{Fore.CYAN}SANDBOX MENU{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            print(f"{Fore.CYAN}{'='*50}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            print("1. Analyze sample")
            print("2. View monitoring logs")
            print("3. Run analysis report")
            print("4. Clean up sandbox")
            print("5. View statistics")
            print("0. Exit")
            
            choice = input(f"\n{Fore.YELLOW}Enter choice: {Style.RESET_ALL}")
            
            if choice == '1':
                sample = input("Enter path to sample file: ")
                result = self.analyze_sample(sample)
                if result:
                    print(f"{Fore.GREEN}[✓] Sample prepared for analysis{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            
            elif choice == '2':
                monitor_dir = self.components.get('monitoring')
                if monitor_dir and os.path.exists(monitor_dir):
                    subprocess.run(['ls', '-la', monitor_dir])
                else:
                    print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] No monitoring logs found{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            
            elif choice == '3':
                analysis_script = os.path.join(self.components.get('monitoring', ''), 'analyze.sh')
                if os.path.exists(analysis_script):
                    subprocess.run(['bash', analysis_script])
                else:
                    print(f"{Fore.YELLOW}[!] Analysis script not found{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            
            elif choice == '4':
                self.cleanup()
                self.sandbox_ready = False
                break
            
            elif choice == '5':
                print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}📊 Statistics:{Style.RESET_ALL}")
                print(f"  Samples Analyzed: {self.stats['samples_analyzed']}")
                print(f"  Suspicious Files: {self.stats['suspicious_files']}")
                print(f"  Network Connections: {self.stats['network_connections']}")
                print(f"  Uptime: {int(time.time() - self.stats['start_time'])} seconds")
            
            elif choice == '0':
                break

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Sandbox Setup for Trojan Analysis')
    parser.add_argument('--dir', default='/sandbox', help='Sandbox directory')
    parser.add_argument('--no-network', action='store_true', help='Disable network isolation')
    parser.add_argument('--no-snapshot', action='store_true', help='Disable snapshots')
    parser.add_argument('--setup', action='store_true', help='Run sandbox setup')
    parser.add_argument('--interactive', action='store_true', help='Interactive mode')
    parser.add_argument('--analyze', help='Analyze a sample file')
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    sandbox = SandboxSetup(
        sandbox_dir=args.dir,
        network_isolation=not args.no_network,
        snapshot_enabled=not args.no_snapshot
    )
    
    if args.setup:
        sandbox.setup()
    
    if args.analyze:
        if not sandbox.sandbox_ready:
            sandbox.setup()
        sandbox.analyze_sample(args.analyze)
    
    if args.interactive:
        if not sandbox.sandbox_ready:
            sandbox.setup()
        sandbox.interactive_menu()
    
    if not any([args.setup, args.analyze, args.interactive]):
        print("Use --setup to create sandbox or --interactive for menu")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

What it is

Baiting leaves something tempting, usually a USB drive labelled "Payroll" or "Confidential", where a victim will find it. Plugging it in runs malware, or the device pretends to be a keyboard and types attack commands.

How it works

Two mechanisms are common. Storage media carry files that look like documents but are programs (double extensions such as invoice.pdf.exe, autorun files, shortcuts, macros). Programmable USB devices present themselves as a keyboard and send keystrokes faster than a person, opening a shell and downloading malware in seconds.

Real-world example

In 2008 the US Department of Defense suffered a widely reported compromise by the agent.btz worm, spread through removable media, which led to a ban on USB drives across military networks. Add a primary source when expanding this section.

Detection

  • Inspect the drive without opening anything: autorun files, executables in the root, double extensions, macro documents (usb_bait_scanner.py)
  • A "storage" device that also presents a keyboard interface (keystroke-injection signature)
  • Endpoint alerts for new USB device classes; logs of newly attached devices

Prevention

In order of strength. The first items fix the cause; the rest reduce risk.

  1. Disable autorun and autoplay; block unknown removable storage with device control (allow-list approved devices)
  2. Block USB HID devices from unmanaged storage-class devices where possible
  3. Teach staff: never plug in found media; hand it to IT
  4. Give IT a sacrificial or kiosk machine that mounts media read-only (mount -o ro,noexec,nosuid,nodev)
  5. Keep endpoint protection current and restrict macros in Office documents

Scripts in this topic

  • usb_bait_scanner.py: read-only folder and USB descriptor checks

Common mistakes

  • Believing a drive is safe because it looks new or sealed
  • Scanning with antivirus after opening the files
  • Treating only storage devices as a risk: charging cables and keyboards can also be implants

Test it safely

Use an empty folder or a throwaway virtual machine. Never test with real malware.

References

  • MITRE ATT&CK T1091
  • MITRE ATT&CK T1200

headings.text: Key Signs of a Suspicious Site

topics.html:
Description

Phishing is a type of social engineering attack where attackers impersonate legitimate organizations or individuals to trick victims into revealing sensitive information, clicking malicious links, or opening infected attachments.

Types of Phishing

1. Email Phishing

  • Mass emails to many recipients
  • Impersonates trusted brands
  • Contains malicious links/attachments

2. Spear Phishing

  • Targeted at specific individuals
  • Personalized using victim's information
  • Highly convincing and dangerous

3. Whaling

  • Targets executives and VIPs
  • Uses business-related themes
  • Financial or data theft focus

4. Clone Phishing

  • Copies legitimate emails
  • Replaces links/attachments
  • Exploits previous correspondence

5. Angler Phishing

  • Uses social media
  • Fake customer support accounts
  • Intercepts complaints

6. Search Engine Phishing

  • Creates fake websites
  • SEO poisoning
  • Appears in search results

Detection Methods

Technical Analysis

  • Email header analysis
  • Link reputation checking
  • Attachment sandboxing
  • Domain age checking
  • SSL certificate validation

Behavioral Analysis

  • Urgency indicators
  • Language patterns
  • Request types
  • Sender behavior

Detection Scripts

  • Phishing Detector - Comprehensive analysis
  • Email Analyzer - Header and content parsing

Prevention Strategies

Technical Controls

  1. SPF/DKIM/DMARC - Email authentication
  2. Email Filtering - Spam and malware filters
  3. Web Filtering - Block malicious sites
  4. MFA - Prevent credential abuse
  5. Endpoint Protection - Block malware

Educational Controls

  1. Regular Training - Spotting phishing attempts
  2. Phishing Simulations - Test employees
  3. Reporting Mechanisms - Easy to report
  4. Security Reminders - Regular communications

Prevention Scripts

  • Training Materials - Educational content
  • Email Filters - Filtering implementation

Phishing Lifecycle

flowchart TD
    A["🧠 Planning"] --> B["⚙️ Setup"]
    B --> C["🚀 Launch"]
    C --> D["👤 User Interaction"]
    D --> E["🔑 Credential Harvesting"]
    E --> F["💰 Monetization"]

    %% Styling
    classDef stage fill:#8e44ad,color:#ffffff,stroke:#4a235a,stroke-width:2px;
    class A,B,C,D,E,F stage;

Phishing Indicators

Email Headers

Return-Path: <different-from-sender>
Reply-To: <suspicious-domain.com>
Authentication-Results: spf=fail
DKIM-Signature: missing or invalid
Message-ID: unusual format
Received: from suspicious IP

What These Mean

  • Return-Path different from sender
    → Possible spoofing or bounce address mismatch.

  • Suspicious Reply-To domain
    → Replies may go to attacker-controlled inbox.

  • SPF = fail
    → Sending server is not authorized for that domain.

  • Missing or invalid DKIM signature
    → Email integrity cannot be verified.

  • Unusual Message-ID format
    → May indicate non-standard mail server or phishing kit.

  • Received from suspicious IP
    → Originates from blacklisted or unexpected geographic location.

Defensive Actions

  • Check SPF, DKIM, and DMARC results.
  • Verify sending domain reputation.
  • Inspect full header chain.
  • Use tools like:
    • MXToolbox
    • Google Admin Toolbox
    • VirusTotal (URL/domain checks)

URL Analysis

Key Signs of a Suspicious Site

IndicatorExample / Description
Display Texthttps://www.paypal.com
Actual Linkhttp://192.168.1.100/paypal/login
Domain AgeLess than 30 days
SSLSelf-signed or expired certificate
CertificateDomain mismatch (certificate does not match URL)

Defensive Actions

  • Always hover over links to check the actual URL.
  • Use WHOIS or domain lookup to verify domain age and ownership.
  • Check SSL/TLS certificate validity and issuer.
  • Verify HTTPS padlock (though some phishing sites use valid SSL).
  • Report suspicious sites to services like:
    • Google Safe Browsing
    • PhishTank
    • APWG

Best Practices

Email Checklist

□ Verify sender email address
□ Hover over links before clicking
□ Check for spelling errors
□ Don't open unexpected attachments
□ Verify requests through other channels
□ Don't enter credentials from emails
□ Report suspicious emails
□ Use separate email for registrations

Technical Implementation

# Email authentication records
SPF Record: "v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com -all"
DKIM: Enable signing for all domains
DMARC: "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@domain.com"

Example Phishing Emails

PayPal Scam

Subject: Urgent: Your account has been limited

Dear Valued Customer,

We noticed unusual activity on your account.
Please verify your information immediately:

[VERIFY YOUR ACCOUNT] (fake link)

Failure to verify will result in account suspension.

Thank you,
PayPal Security Team

CEO Fraud

Subject: Urgent wire transfer

Hi [Employee],

I'm in a meeting and need you to process an urgent wire transfer.
Amount: $50,000
Account: [Fake Account]
Please confirm when done.

Thanks,
[CEO Name]

Phishing Analysis Tools

ToolPurposeType
PhishToolEmail analysisFree/Paid
URLScan.ioURL analysisFree
VirusTotalFile/URL scanFree
Google Safe BrowsingURL reputationFree
PhishTankPhishing databaseFree

References

  • Phishing.org
  • APWG Phishing Activity Reports
  • FTC Phishing Guide
  • CISA Phishing Infographic

scripts.summary: Email Analyzer This script analyzes email headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC records, and performs deep inspection of email content for phishing indicators.
scripts.source:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Email Analyzer
This script analyzes email headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC records, and performs
deep inspection of email content for phishing indicators.
"""

import os
import sys
import re
import json
import argparse
import dns.resolver
import smtplib
import socket
from email import policy
from email.parser import BytesParser
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import base64
from colorama import init, Fore, Style

init(autoreset=True)

class EmailAnalyzer:
    """
    Deep Email Analysis Tool
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.results = {
            'headers': {},
            'authentication': {},
            'security': {},
            'analysis': {}
        }
        
    def parse_email(self, email_file):
        """Parse email file"""
        try:
            with open(email_file, 'rb') as f:
                msg = BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parse(f)
            return msg
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"{Fore.RED}[!] Error parsing email: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            return None
    
    def analyze_headers_deep(self, msg):
        """Deep header analysis"""
        headers = {}
        
        # Essential headers
        essential = ['From', 'To', 'Subject', 'Date', 'Message-ID', 
                     'Return-Path', 'Reply-To', 'Sender']
        
        for header in essential:
            value = msg.get(header, '')
            headers[header] = value
            
            # Analyze From header
            if header == 'From':
                from_domain = self.extract_domain(value)
                headers['from_domain'] = from_domain
                
                # Check for display name spoofing
                if '"' in value and '<' in value:
                    headers['display_name_spoof'] = True
        
        # Get all received headers
        headers['received'] = msg.get_all('Received', [])
        
        # Analyze received path
        headers['received_analysis'] = self.analyze_received_path(headers['received'])
        
        # Get authentication results
        headers['auth_results'] = msg.get('Authentication-Results', '')
        
        # Get DKIM signature
        headers['dkim_signature'] = msg.get('DKIM-Signature', '')
        
        # Get ARC headers
        headers['arc'] = {
            'seal': msg.get('ARC-Seal', ''),
            'message-signature': msg.get('ARC-Message-Signature', ''),
            'authentication-results': msg.get('ARC-Authentication-Results', '')
        }
        
        return headers
    
    def analyze_received_path(self, received_headers):
        """Analyze the Received header path"""
        analysis = {
            'hops': len(received_headers),
            'servers': [],
            'suspicious': []
        }
        
        for received in received_headers:
            # Extract server info
            server_info = {}
            
            # Look for "from" server
            from_match = re.search(r'from\s+([^\s]+)', received, re.IGNORECASE)
            if from_match:
                server_info['from'] = from_match.group(1)
            
            # Look for "by" server
            by_match = re.search(r'by\s+([^\s]+)', received, re.IGNORECASE)
            if by_match:
                server_info['by'] = by_match.group(1)
            
            # Look for "with" protocol
            with_match = re.search(r'with\s+([^\s]+)', received, re.IGNORECASE)
            if with_match:
                server_info['with'] = with_match.group(1)
            
            # Look for IP
            ip_match = re.search(r'\[(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)\]', received)
            if ip_match:
                server_info['ip'] = ip_match.group(1)
            
            # Look for timestamp
            time_match = re.search(r';\s*(.+)$', received)
            if time_match:
                server_info['time'] = time_match.group(1)
            
            analysis['servers'].append(server_info)
            
            # Check for suspicious patterns
            if 'unknown' in received.lower():
                analysis['suspicious'].append('Unknown server in path')
            if 'untrusted' in received.lower():
                analysis['suspicious'].append('Untrusted server in path')
        
        return analysis
    
    def check_spf(self, domain, sender_ip=None):
        """Check SPF record for domain"""
        result = {
            'record': None,
            'valid': False,
            'error': None
        }
        
        try:
            # Query SPF record
            answers = dns.resolver.resolve(domain, 'TXT')
            for rdata in answers:
                txt = rdata.to_text()
                if 'v=spf1' in txt:
                    result['record'] = txt.strip('"')
                    result['valid'] = True
                    break
        except dns.resolver.NoAnswer:
            result['error'] = 'No SPF record found'
        except dns.resolver.NXDOMAIN:
            result['error'] = 'Domain does not exist'
        except Exception as e:
            result['error'] = str(e)
        
        return result
    
    def check_dkim(self, domain, selector='default'):
        """Check DKIM record for domain"""
        result = {
            'record': None,
            'valid': False,
            'error': None
        }
        
        try:
            # Query DKIM record
            dkim_domain = f'{selector}._domainkey.{domain}'
            answers = dns.resolver.resolve(dkim_domain, 'TXT')
            for rdata in answers:
                txt = rdata.to_text()
                if 'v=DKIM1' in txt:
                    result['record'] = txt.strip('"')
                    result['valid'] = True
                    break
        except dns.resolver.NoAnswer:
            result['error'] = 'No DKIM record found'
        except Exception as e:
            result['error'] = str(e)
        
        return result
    
    def check_dmarc(self, domain):
        """Check DMARC record for domain"""
        result = {
            'record': None,
            'policy': None,
            'valid': False,
            'error': None
        }
        
        try:
            # Query DMARC record
            dmarc_domain = f'_dmarc.{domain}'
            answers = dns.resolver.resolve(dmarc_domain, 'TXT')
            for rdata in answers:
                txt = rdata.to_text()
                if 'v=DMARC1' in txt:
                    result['record'] = txt.strip('"')
                    result['valid'] = True
                    
                    # Extract policy
                    policy_match = re.search(r'p=(\w+)', txt)
                    if policy_match:
                        result['policy'] = policy_match.group(1)
                    break
        except dns.resolver.NoAnswer:
            result['error'] = 'No DMARC record found'
        except Exception as e:
            result['error'] = str(e)
        
        return result
    
    def verify_ssl_certificate(self, domain):
        """Verify SSL certificate of mail server"""
        result = {
            'valid': False,
            'issuer': None,
            'expiry': None,
            'error': None
        }
        
        try:
            # Get MX records
            mx_records = dns.resolver.resolve(domain, 'MX')
            mx_record = str(mx_records[0].exchange).rstrip('.')
            
            # Try to connect to mail server
            import ssl
            import socket
            
            context = ssl.create_default_context()
            with socket.create_connection((mx_record, 587), timeout=5) as sock:
                with context.wrap_socket(sock, server_hostname=mx_record) as ssock:
                    cert = ssock.getpeercert()
                    
                    # Get issuer
                    issuer = dict(x[0] for x in cert['issuer'])
                    result['issuer'] = issuer.get('organizationName', 'Unknown')
                    
                    # Get expiry
                    from datetime import datetime
                    not_after = cert.get('notAfter')
                    if not_after:
                        expiry = datetime.strptime(not_after, '%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y %Z')
                        result['expiry'] = expiry.isoformat()
                        result['valid'] = expiry > datetime.now()
                    
        except Exception as e:
            result['error'] = str(e)
        
        return result
    
    def extract_domain(self, email):
        """Extract domain from email address"""
        match = re.search(r'@([^>\s]+)', email)
        if match:
            return match.group(1).lower()
        return None
    
    def analyze_phishing_patterns(self, msg):
        """Analyze content for phishing patterns"""
        patterns = {
            'urgency': [
                r'urgent',
                r'immediate action',
                r'account.*suspended',
                r'security.*alert',
                r'unusual activity'
            ],
            'threats': [
                r'will be closed',
                r'will be deleted',
                r'legal action',
                r'prosecution'
            ],
            'requests': [
                r'verify.*account',
                r'confirm.*information',
                r'update.*details',
                r'click.*link'
            ]
        }
        
        findings = {
            'urgency': [],
            'threats': [],
            'requests': []
        }
        
        # Get email body
        body = ''
        if msg.is_multipart():
            for part in msg.walk():
                if part.get_content_type() in ['text/plain', 'text/html']:
                    body += part.get_payload(decode=True).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
        else:
            body = msg.get_payload(decode=True).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
        
        body_lower = body.lower()
        
        for category, pattern_list in patterns.items():
            for pattern in pattern_list:
                if re.search(pattern, body_lower):
                    findings[category].append(pattern)
        
        return findings
    
    def analyze_email(self, email_file):
        """Complete email analysis"""
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Analyzing email: {email_file}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        msg = self.parse_email(email_file)
        if not msg:
            return None
        
        # Analyze headers
        self.results['headers'] = self.analyze_headers_deep(msg)
        
        # Extract domain
        from_header = self.results['headers'].get('From', '')
        domain = self.extract_domain(from_header)
        
        if domain:
            # Check SPF
            print(f"{Fore.CYAN}  [*] Checking SPF for {domain}...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            self.results['authentication']['spf'] = self.check_spf(domain)
            
            # Check DKIM
            print(f"{Fore.CYAN}  [*] Checking DKIM for {domain}...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            self.results['authentication']['dkim'] = self.check_dkim(domain)
            
            # Check DMARC
            print(f"{Fore.CYAN}  [*] Checking DMARC for {domain}...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            self.results['authentication']['dmarc'] = self.check_dmarc(domain)
            
            # Check SSL certificate
            print(f"{Fore.CYAN}  [*] Verifying SSL certificate...{Style.RESET_ALL}")
            self.results['security']['ssl'] = self.verify_ssl_certificate(domain)
        
        # Analyze phishing patterns
        self.results['analysis']['phishing_patterns'] = self.analyze_phishing_patterns(msg)
        
        # Calculate risk score
        self.results['analysis']['risk_score'] = self.calculate_risk_score()
        self.results['analysis']['risk_level'] = self.get_risk_level(
            self.results['analysis']['risk_score']
        )
        
        return self.results
    
    def calculate_risk_score(self):
        """Calculate overall risk score"""
        score = 0
        
        # Check SPF
        spf = self.results.get('authentication', {}).get('spf', {})
        if not spf.get('valid'):
            score += 20
        
        # Check DKIM
        dkim = self.results.get('authentication', {}).get('dkim', {})
        if not dkim.get('valid'):
            score += 20
        
        # Check DMARC
        dmarc = self.results.get('authentication', {}).get('dmarc', {})
        if not dmarc.get('valid'):
            score += 20
        elif dmarc.get('policy') == 'none':
            score += 10
        
        # Check SSL
        ssl = self.results.get('security', {}).get('ssl', {})
        if not ssl.get('valid'):
            score += 15
        
        # Check phishing patterns
        patterns = self.results.get('analysis', {}).get('phishing_patterns', {})
        score += len(patterns.get('urgency', [])) * 5
        score += len(patterns.get('threats', [])) * 10
        score += len(patterns.get('requests', [])) * 5
        
        # Check received path
        received_analysis = self.results.get('headers', {}).get('received_analysis', {})
        score += len(received_analysis.get('suspicious', [])) * 10
        
        return min(score, 100)
    
    def get_risk_level(self, score):
        """Get risk level from score"""
        if score >= 70:
            return 'CRITICAL'
        elif score >= 50:
            return 'HIGH'
        elif score >= 30:
            return 'MEDIUM'
        else:
            return 'LOW'
    
    def print_report(self):
        """Print analysis report"""
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}{'='*60}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        print(f"{Fore.CYAN}📊 EMAIL ANALYSIS REPORT{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        print(f"{Fore.CYAN}{'='*60}{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        # Risk level
        risk_level = self.results.get('analysis', {}).get('risk_level', 'UNKNOWN')
        risk_score = self.results.get('analysis', {}).get('risk_score', 0)
        
        risk_color = {
            'LOW': Fore.GREEN,
            'MEDIUM': Fore.YELLOW,
            'HIGH': Fore.RED,
            'CRITICAL': Fore.RED + Style.BRIGHT
        }.get(risk_level, Fore.WHITE)
        
        print(f"\n{risk_color}Risk Level: {risk_level} (Score: {risk_score}){Style.RESET_ALL}")
        
        # Headers
        print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}📨 Email Headers:{Style.RESET_ALL}")
        headers = self.results.get('headers', {})
        print(f"  From: {headers.get('From', 'N/A')}")
        print(f"  To: {headers.get('To', 'N/A')}")
        print(f"  Subject: {headers.get('Subject', 'N/A')}")
        print(f"  Date: {headers.get('Date', 'N/A')}")

Suspicious TLDs self.suspicious_tlds = [ '.tk', '.ml', '.ga', '.cf', '.gq', # Free TLDs '.xyz', '.top', '.win', '.bid', '.trade', # Cheap TLDs '.review', '.date', '.download', '.loan' # Spammy TLDs ] # Trusted domains (whitelist) self.trusted_domains = [ 'google.com', 'microsoft.com', 'apple.com', 'amazon.com', 'paypal.com', 'facebook.com', 'twitter.com', 'linkedin.com', 'github.com', 'dropbox.com', 'box.com', 'salesforce.com' ] # Statistics self.stats = { 'emails_analyzed': 0, 'urls_analyzed': 0, 'phishing_detected': 0, 'suspicious_findings': 0 } def analyze_email_file(self, email_file): """Analyze email from .eml file""" print(f"\n{Fore.CYAN}[*] Analyzing email file: {email_file}{Style.RESET_ALL}") try: with open(email_file, 'rb') as f: msg = BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parse(f) results = { 'filename': email_file, 'headers': self.analyze_headers(msg), 'links': self.extract_links(msg), 'attachments': self.extract_attachments(msg), 'content': self.analyze_content(msg), 'spf_dkim_dmarc': self.check_email_auth(msg), 'risk_score': 0, 'risk_level': 'LOW', 'findings': [] } # Analyze headers header_results = self.analyze_headers(msg) results['headers'] = header_results for note in header_results.get('suspicious', []): results['findings'].append({'type': 'header_anomaly', 'detail': note}) # Extract and analyze links links = self.extract_links(msg) results['links'] = links for link in links: link_analysis = self.analyze_url(link['url']) if link_analysis['risk_level'] != 'LOW': results['findings'].append({ 'type': 'suspicious_link', 'url': link['url'], 'analysis': link_analysis }) # Analyze attachments attachments = self.extract_attachments(msg) results['attachments'] = attachments for attachment in attachments: if attachment['extension'] in ['.exe', '.scr', '.zip', '.js', '.vbs']: results['findings'].append({ 'type': 'dangerous_attachment', 'filename': attachment['filename'], 'extension': attachment['extension'] }) # Analyze content content_results = self.analyze_content(msg) results['content'] = content_results if content_results['suspicious_keywords']: results['findings'].append({ 'type': 'suspicious_keywords', 'keywords': content_results['suspicious_keywords'] }) # Check email authentication auth_results = self.check_email_auth(msg) results['spf_dkim_dmarc'] = auth_results if not auth_results.get('spf_pass', True): results['findings'].append({ 'type': 'spf_fail', 'details': auth_results.get('spf_details', 'SPF check failed') }) # Calculate risk score results['risk_score'] = self.calculate_risk_score(results) results['risk_level'] = self.get_risk_level(results['risk_score']) self.stats['emails_analyzed'] += 1 if results['risk_level'] in ['HIGH', 'CRITICAL']: self.stats['phishing_detected'] += 1 elif results['risk_level'] == 'MEDIUM': self.stats['suspicious_findings'] += 1 return results except Exception as e: print(f"{Fore.RED}[!] Error analyzing email: {e}{Style.RESET_ALL}") return None def analyze_headers(self, msg): """Analyze email headers for spoofing indicators""" results = { 'from': msg.get('From', ''), 'reply-to': msg.get('Reply-To', ''), 'return-path': msg.get('Return-Path', ''), 'subject': msg.get('Subject', ''), 'date': msg.get('Date', ''), 'message-id': msg.get('Message-ID', ''), 'received': [], 'suspicious': [] } # Check Return-Path return_path = msg.get('Return-Path', '') if return_path and from_domain: return_domain = self.extract_domain(return_path) if return_domain and return_domain != from_domain: results['suspicious'].append(f"Return-Path domain ({return_domain}) differs from From domain ({from_domain})") # Parse Received headers received_headers = msg.get_all('Received', []) for received in received_headers: results['received'].append(received[:100] + '...' if len(received) > 100 else received) # Check for suspicious relays if 'unknown' in received.lower() or 'untrusted' in received.lower(): results['suspicious'].append(f"Suspicious relay in Received header") # Get email body if msg.is_multipart(): for part in msg.walk(): if part.get_content_type() == 'text/html': body = part.get_payload(decode=True).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore') self.extract_links_from_html(body, links) elif part.get_content_type() == 'text/plain': body = part.get_payload(decode=True).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore') self.extract_links_from_text(body, links) else: body = msg.get_payload(decode=True).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore') if msg.get_content_type() == 'text/html': self.extract_links_from_html(body, links) else: self.extract_links_from_text(body, links) return links def extract_links_from_html(self, html, links): """Extract links from HTML content""" # Simple regex for href links href_pattern = r'href=["\'](https?://[^"\']+)["\']' for match in re.finditer(href_pattern, html, re.IGNORECASE): url = match.group(1) # Try to find display text link_text = '' text_pattern = r'>([^<]+)' text_match = re.search(text_pattern, html[match.end():match.end()+200]) if text_match: link_text = text_match.group(1) links.append({ 'url': url, 'text': link_text, 'type': 'html' }) # Extract from text content self.extract_links_from_text(html, links) def extract_links_from_text(self, text, links): """Extract links from plain text""" url_pattern = r'https?://[^\s<>"\'(){}|\\^`\[\]]+' for match in re.finditer(url_pattern, text): url = match.group(0) if not any(l['url'] == url for l in links): links.append({ 'url': url, 'text': '', 'type': 'text' }) def extract_attachments(self, msg): """Extract attachment information""" attachments = [] if msg.is_multipart(): for part in msg.walk(): if part.get_content_disposition() == 'attachment': filename = part.get_filename() if filename: attachments.append({ 'filename': filename, 'extension': os.path.splitext(filename)[1].lower(), 'size': len(part.get_payload(decode=True) or b''), 'content_type': part.get_content_type() }) return attachments def analyze_content(self, msg): """Analyze email content for phishing keywords""" results = { 'suspicious_keywords': [], 'urgency_indicators': [], 'grammar_issues': [] } # Get email body body = '' if msg.is_multipart(): for part in msg.walk(): if part.get_content_type() in ['text/plain', 'text/html']: body += part.get_payload(decode=True).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore') else: body = msg.get_payload(decode=True).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore') body_lower = body.lower() # Check for suspicious keywords for keyword in self.phishing_keywords: if keyword in body_lower: results['suspicious_keywords'].append(keyword) # Check for urgency indicators urgency_words = ['immediate', 'urgent', 'asap', 'warning', 'alert', 'suspended', 'locked'] for word in urgency_words: if word in body_lower: results['urgency_indicators'].append(word) # Check for poor grammar (simplified) grammar_patterns = [ r'your\s+account\s+will\s+be', r'click\s+the\s+below', r'kindly\s+update', r'we\s+have\s+noticed' ] for pattern in grammar_patterns: if re.search(pattern, body_lower): results['grammar_issues'].append(f"Pattern: {pattern}") return results PHISH_KEYWORDS = ('login', 'signin', 'verify', 'secure', 'account', 'update', 'password', 'confirm', 'billing') HOMOGLYPHS = str.maketrans({'0': 'o', '1': 'l', '3': 'e', '5': 's', '$': 's', '@': 'a'}) @staticmethod def _edit_distance(a, b): """Levenshtein distance (small strings only).""" previous = list(range(len(b) + 1)) for i, ca in enumerate(a, 1): current = [i] for j, cb in enumerate(b, 1): current.append(min(previous[j] + 1, current[j - 1] + 1, previous[j - 1] + (ca != cb))) previous = current return previous[-1] def _lookalike_brand(self, domain): """Return the trusted brand a hostname imitates (paypa1, micros0ft, paypall ...), else None. in self.trusted_domains: return None tokens = [t for t in re.split(r'[.\-_]', domain.lower()) if len(t) >= 4] for trusted in self.trusted_domains: brand = trusted.split('.')[0] for token in tokens: folded = token.translate(self.HOMOGLYPHS).replace('rn', 'm').replace('vv', 'w') if token != brand and (folded == brand or (len(token) >= 5 and self._edit_distance(folded, brand) == 1)): return trusted parsed.netloc, 'path': parsed.path, 'params': parsed.params, 'query': parsed.query, 'fragment': parsed.fragment } # Extract domain domain = parsed.netloc.lower() if ':' in domain: domain = topics.summary: Pretexting is a form of social engineering where attackers create a fabricated scenario (pretext) to steal information or gain access. Unlike phishing which uses technical deception, pretexting relies on building a false sense of trust through impersonation and elaborate stories.
topics.html:
Description

Pretexting is a form of social engineering where attackers create a fabricated scenario (pretext) to steal information or gain access. Unlike phishing which uses technical deception, pretexting relies on building a false sense of trust through impersonation and elaborate stories.

Types of Pretexting

1. Impersonation

  • Posing as IT support
  • Fake law enforcement -冒充 executives
  • Vendor impersonation

2. Research Surveys

  • Fake market research
  • Academic studies
  • Customer satisfaction surveys
  • Political polling

3. Charity Scams

  • Fake disaster relief
  • Fundraising for fake causes
  • Religious organization scams
  • Crowdfunding fraud

4. Romance Scams

  • Dating site manipulation
  • Long-distance relationships
  • Emergency money requests
  • Gift card demands

5. Tech Support Scams

  • Fake virus alerts
  • Software update calls
  • Account recovery assistance
  • Warranty renewal scams

6. Government Impersonation

  • Fake IRS agents
  • Social Security calls
  • Immigration officers
  • Court officials

Detection Methods

Call Analysis

  • Caller ID verification
  • Voice pattern analysis
  • Call-back verification
  • Background noise analysis

Story Verification

  • Fact-checking claims
  • Cross-referencing information
  • Timeline analysis
  • Consistency checking

Detection Scripts

  • Social Engineering Detector - Call/sms analysis

Prevention Strategies

Technical Controls

  1. Call Authentication - STIR/SHAKEN for calls
  2. Number Blocking - Block known scam numbers
  3. Robocall Filtering - Identify automated calls
  4. Voice Biometrics - Speaker verification

Administrative Controls

  1. Verification Protocols - Always verify through official channels
  2. Information Classification - Label sensitive data
  3. Need-to-Know Basis - Limit information access
  4. Dual Authorization - Require two approvals

Prevention Scripts

  • Security Policy - Policy templates

Pretexting Attack Cycle

    A["🔍 Research Target"] --> B["✏️ Create Scenario"]
    B --> C["📞 Establish Contact"]
    C --> D["🤝 Build Trust"]
    D --> E["💾 Extract Information"]
    E --> F["🚪 Exit Gracefully"]

    %% Styling
    classDef stage fill:#e67e22,color:#ffffff,stroke:#a84300,stroke-width:2px;

Pretexting Indicators

Phone Call Red Flags

  • ☑ Caller asks you to verify personal information
  • ☑ Unsolicited tech support calls
  • ☑ Caller claims to be from a government agency
  • ☑ Demands immediate payment
  • ☑ Requests payment via gift cards
  • ☑ Caller ID shows "Unknown" or a spoofed number
  • ☑ Background noise sounds like a call center
  • ☑ Scripted conversation with unnatural pauses

In-Person Red Flags

  • ☑ No visible ID badge
  • ☑ Vague purpose for visit
  • ☑ Asks to borrow equipment
  • ☑ Too friendly or pushy
  • ☑ Inquires about security procedures
  • ☑ Shows up at unusual times
  • ☑ Claims an emergency situation

Best Practices

Phone Call Verification

# Phone Call Security Checklist

□ Never give out personal information to incoming calls
□ Hang up and call back using official number
□ Verify identity through multiple channels
□ Be wary of caller ID - it can be faked
□ Don't trust "verify your identity" requests
□ Government agencies never demand immediate payment

In-Person Verification

# Visitor Verification Checklist

□ Always ask for ID
□ Verify with the person they claim to represent
□ Escort visitors at all times
□ Report suspicious individuals
□ Don't hold doors for strangers
□ Challenge people in restricted areas

Example Pretexting Scenarios

Tech Support Scam

Caller: "Hello, this is Microsoft Windows Support. We've detected
multiple viruses on your computer. I need you to install this software
to clean your system."

Victim: "I didn't report any problems."

Caller: "This is from our automated monitoring system. If you don't
act now, your computer will be disabled in 24 hours."

IRS Impersonation

Caller: "This is Officer Smith from the IRS. There's a warrant for
your arrest for tax evasion. You need to pay $5,000 immediately via
gift cards to avoid prosecution."

Victim: "That sounds serious."

Caller: "It is! But if you pay now, we can resolve this. Go to
Walgreens and buy $5,000 in Google Play gift cards. Call me back
with the codes."

Charity Scam

Caller: "Hi, I'm calling from the National Police Benevolent Association.
We're raising funds for families of fallen officers. Can you help?"

Victim: "I'd like to help."

Caller: "Thank you! We accept credit cards or bank transfers.
Let me take your information..."
